stem: A circle has radius ${=r}$ cm. Find the length of an arc subtending a central angle of ${=ang}^\circ$, taking $\pi = \frac{22}{7}$.
solution: An arc is the same fraction of the circumference as its angle is of $360^\circ$.
notes: Reproduces the hand-written family tpl:geo2-1-2:arc in generate_questions.py, item for item (decision 16 proof, tests/test_family_reproduction.py). Misconception ids are the catalogue's (seed/generated/misconceptions.json), which the live bank carries. Not loaded by anything: the live Prep-3 bank is the committed export.
